title: Dark at 5 PM and Your Porch Is Pitch Black? | Smart Home Fixes #3

beats.text: Dark at 5 PM? A lot of porch lights miss one job, and it's not brightness.
The Sunset Rule. On at sunset, off on a timer.
And the part most people miss: light the door, not the yard, so your camera sees faces, not shadows.
Easiest upgrade: a floodlight camera. Light and camera in one.
Is your porch light on a schedule yet?
We're a small local business aiming for 100 subscribers by December 31. Subscribing helps a lot.
Follow for number 4: leak sensors before the first freeze. Free quote at novaprohome.com.
